title: CGA on the grade engine: equivalence harness and solver 2
environment: darwin-arm64; Node 22.23.1, pnpm 10.29.3, Playwright 1.62.1/Chromium 1234, FFmpeg 8.0.1 (pnpm toolchain:check passed). The first exploratory runs used Node 24.16.0 by mistake; every recorded check was rerun on 22.23.1.
visualAcceptance: none; software measurements only. The owner's CGA visual review is still pending and is planned on the A6 sheets.

equivalenceBound.units: of 255, per clip, solver 2 against solver 1 exact Canvas predictions at full resolution (12 sampled frames)
equivalenceBound.stated: 2026-11-23, before the first measurement; which metric is the look bound stays open (owner decision 4)

mappings.difference: max 1 code over a color cube and the neutral ramp for 18 temperature/tint settings; 71 of 27,648 table values off by 1 over 36 settings
mappings.note: grade.white-balance (Bradford) is the opt-in adaptation model: neutrals within 1, saturated colors up to 28 codes on the synthetic green

mappings.difference: max 1 code in range; values outside 0–1 are kept instead of clipped

mappings.solver2: grade.curves master with kink guard points (piecewiseCurve), lumaMix 0
mappings.difference: max 1 code (0 on the owner clip that exposed the unguarded spline, which had been 3)

mappings.solver2: grade.key (HSL hue 25° ± 25° smoothstep, inverted, gain protectSkin, offset 1 − protectSkin) + grade.primary colorBoost
mappings.difference: max 3, p99 ≤ 1 over the color cube for protectSkin 0, 0.7, 1; a saturated orange unchanged
max 1 code in range (as CG2 measured)

checks.check: Synthetic fixtures: solver 2 meets solver 1's CGA bounds (exposure ≤ 3, contrast ≤ 2.5, white balance ≤ 1, balanced identity, clipping budget, banding bound) and the equivalence bound

checks.test: integration: solution JSON identical on rerun

checks.check: Owner clips: solver 2 within the equivalence bound, or each difference listed with its cause
checks.evidence: 43 of 44 gated rows (gains white balance) within the bound; see ownerClips and outside

checks.check: Prediction equals the Canvas render exactly; WebGL2 within the CG2 parity bound
checks.test: pnpm test:browser:color-grading-cga2: two synthetic fixtures (flat with skin key; narrow range with the S-curve), 12 frames each, png8 renders: Canvas 0 and WebGL2 0 channels off

checks.check: --engine legacy and the default are CGA unchanged
checks.evidence: the existing 21 CGA integration tests pass unchanged; legacy reports carry no engine fields

checks.check: A tungsten-cast fixture that solver 1 cannot reach is corrected
checks.evidence: Bradford white balance cannot pass the equivalence gate (decision 2), so it moved to A4 with this check

ownerClips.note: local only, never committed; the look is the CGA owner look at the default 0.6. look+auto is not a default mode (it needs --adaptive true).

listedDifferences.cause: headroom and rounding, not the mapping: both solvers choose the same parameters (temperature −21.52 vs −21.55, vibrance 71.19 both) and translating solver 1's own parameters gives the same p99 4. CGA clips and rounds the look's output to 8 bits before its corrections; the grade run keeps the look's out-of-range values. Clipping and rounding the look output first brings p99 to 2; the rest is CGA's per-stage rounding

listedDifferences.difference: synthetic casts p99 8 and 28; three owner look+auto rows block RMS 1.02–1.16
listedDifferences.cause: Bradford adaptation moves saturated colors differently from channel gains; reported only, not gated, and moved to A4

rejected.reason: fails the equivalence gate on saturated colors (synthetic p99 8 and 28); kept as the opt-in adaptation model for A4

rejected.experiment: grade.hue-curves hueVsSat skin dip (decision 3's first recommendation)
rejected.reason: one chroma factor per hue also desaturates strong skin-hued colors that vibrance leaves alone: up to 26 codes on a saturated orange, p99 12 over the color cube

rejected.experiment: grade.curves through color.curves' own points (unguarded spline)
rejected.reason: rounds the kinks by up to 3 codes and, through the predicted clipping, made solver 2 scale every correction back ×0.75 on one owner clip (block RMS 1.58, p99 5)

rejected.experiment: gain curves with uniform spacing and no knee guard
rejected.reason: PCHIP flattened the segment before the clip knee: up to 3 codes

verification.checkFast: passed on the final code (schema, boundaries, format, lint, build, package types, 483 files / 4,994 tests)
verification.notRun: pnpm check, the full pnpm test, other browser groups and the release checks

a2.title: Reports and measurement on scopes
a2.environment: darwin-arm64; Node 22.23.1, pnpm 10.29.3, Playwright 1.62.1/Chromium 1234, FFmpeg 8.0.1 (pnpm toolchain:check passed)
a2.visualAcceptance: none; software measurements only. The --diff stills and sheets were checked byte for byte against comp grade diff, not looked at by a person.

legacyReports.decision: versioned: report 1 unchanged for --engine legacy without --scopes; report 2 (engine, solver, scopes) for every --engine grade run and for legacy with --scopes true
legacyReports.evidence: scripts/color/cga2-reports.ts on 2413125c (A1) and on this branch, the same input clips: 6/6 legacy reports byte-identical (one with a render and audio); 6/6 grade reports equal A1's except schemaVersion (report-1 → report-2) and the added scopes block

checks.test: tests/integration/composition-color.test.ts (CGA2 A2): AutoColorReportSchema accepts report 1 and report 2 and rejects report 1 with scopes or report 2 without; autoColorClip validates before publishing
integration: two grade runs give identical reports apart from the composition path

checks.check: Statistics fields that already existed are unchanged on the fixtures
checks.evidence: legacy reports byte-identical to A1 (above); report 2 carries every report-1 field with the same values (integration); before equals comp scopes' statistics and predicted equals the statistics of the exact prediction

checks.check: Embedded scopes are comp scopes' numbers
checks.test: integration: scopes.before equals measureColorScopes(input, 12 frames).measurement; scopes.predicted equals measureColorScopeFrames of the prediction

checks.check: --diff writes the expected files and refuses existing ones
checks.test: integration: prediction images equal colorGradeDiffImages; with a render, byte-identical to diffColorGrade(input, output); an existing sheet is refused before any work and nothing is written. CLI: folder look apply writes <stem>.still.png and <stem>.sheet.png per clip; a rerun is refused (comp-auto-color-output, path diff)

checks.check: Canvas and WebGL2 equal the prediction (A1, rerun)
checks.test: pnpm test:browser:color-grading-cga2: both fixtures 0 channels off

synthetic.note: skin-line deviation of the sampled frames, before → predicted (grade engine), degrees; the reference itself sits 12.97° off the 123° line
synthetic.finding: corrections that restore the synthetic reference move skin back to the reference's own angle, which is off the skin line, so the absolute deviation grows; A4's 'does not grow' check needs a reference-relative reading on such sources
